search_text: published ZDI-11-056 ZDI-CAN-420 (0Day) Hewlett-Packard Data Protector Client EXEC_SETUP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2011-02-07 CVE-2011-0922 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2011-0922 10.0 ['Hewlett-Packard'] ['Data Protector'] This vulnerability allows an attacker to execute remote code on vulnerable installations of the Hewlett-Packard Data Protector client. User interaction is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the EXEC_SETUP command. This command instructs a Data Protector client to download and execute a setup file. A malicious attacker can instruct the client to access a file off of a share thus executing arbitrary code under the context of the current user. ['2009-01-26 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2011-02-07 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Anonymous https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-11-056/
title: (0Day) Hewlett-Packard Data Protector Client EXEC_SETUP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows an attacker to execute remote code on vulnerable installations of the Hewlett-Packard Data Protector client. User interaction is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the EXEC_SETUP command. This command instructs a Data Protector client to download and execute a setup file. A malicious attacker can instruct the client to access a file off of a share thus executing arbitrary code under the context of the current user.
